subject: AtlasAI Hosted API commit tiers & regional pricing
messages:
From: Thomas Chen <thomas@atlasai.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@atlasai.com
Date: 2027-02-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing — commit tiers & region mix (AtlasAI)

Hi Rishi,

Quick intro — I'm Thomas (Head of Platform @ AtlasAI). We're evaluating Redwood for our inference layer and wanted to understand how your usage-based discounts and commit tiers behave across regions. Our expected monthly token profile (avg): US 60%, EU 30%, APAC 10%.

Questions:
- Do per-token discounts apply to cross-region usage automatically, or are they region-bound?
- Is there a blended-rate option if we commit at a global level?
- Any APAC surcharge or minimums we should plan for?
- Do rollover credits expire or can they be used across regions?

We're targeting a 24-month commitment if terms look reasonable. Can you send a preliminary structure (3 tiers: 0-2B / 2B-10B / 10B+) and an example blended calc? Also, any timing constraints around credit rollover would be helpful.

Thanks — happy to hop on a call later this week.

Thomas
Thomas Chen
Head of Platform, AtlasAI
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Thomas Chen <thomas@atlasai.com>
Cc: procurement@atlasai.com
Date: 2027-02-14T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — commit tiers & region mix (AtlasAI)

Thanks Thomas — great to hear from you. High level answers up front, then a sketch below.

- Discounts are ordinarily applied at the billed-region level. We do offer a global blended option for committed customers but that’s an explicit contract clause.
- APAC typically carries an effective surcharge (infra + egress) — we commonly add a regional multiplier of ~+10–15% unless we agree a strategic waiver.
- Rollover credits: standard policy is 6-month expiry from the month earned, and by default credits are region-bound. We can negotiate a global rollover pool for larger commitments.

Prelim tier sketch (example per-token rates, USD per 1k tokens):
Tier A (0-2B): $0.018
Tier B (2B-10B): $0.012
Tier C (10B+): $0.0085

If you opt for a 24-month, we can deepen the discount by ~10–20% depending on absolute commit and whether you allow an annual true-up. For APAC we can either: 1) apply +12% on per-token list, or 2) offer a temporary APAC waiver for the first 6 months for strategic customers.

I've attached a short prelim quote based on the profile you shared (see prelim_quote_AtlasAI_Q1.pdf). Can you confirm expected monthly token volumes (absolute numbers — not percentages) and whether a global blended billing model is preferred?

If you want, I can loop in Lauren (sales lead) and Mina (finance) for a one-pager and margin calc.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-14T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: AtlasAI — APAC waiver request (internal)

Rishi — quick internal note. Thomas is a good fit strategically (enterprise AI stack, strong PLG motion). If they go 24 months and commit >= $1.2M ARR equivalent, I recommend we:
- Offer APAC waiver for first 6 months (no surcharge)
- Provide a 15% uplift on discounts across tiers for a 24-month lock with annual true-up
- Allow a global rollover pool but cap at 3 months of average monthly usage to limit leakage

Mina — can you run margin impact (best / likely / worst) if we take the above? Also confirm whether a 6-month expiry for rollover (as Rishi noted) is OK from accounting. If we want global rollover without cap we'll need a pre-paid buffer.

Lauren
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Thomas Chen <thomas@atlasai.com>
Cc: procurement@atlasai.com
Date: 2027-02-15T08:44:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — commit tiers & region mix (AtlasAI)

Hi Thomas — following up with a concrete proposal based on your traffic mix. Summary below (attached is a short SOW and sample pricing table: AtlasAI_SOW_v2.pdf).

Proposal (24-month commit)
- Commit: 6B tokens/mo average (projected usage scale) with annual true-up
- Effective per-1k-token rates (post-commit discounts):
  * Tier A (0-2B): $0.015 (after 15% uplift)
  * Tier B (2B-10B): $0.0102
  * Tier C (10B+): $0.0072
- Blended global rate example (using your split US 60% / EU 30% / APAC 10%, and APAC temporary waiver):
  * Base blended = 0.6*$0.0102 + 0.3*$0.0102 + 0.1*$0.0102 = $0.0102 (same since same list)
  * With APAC surcharge (if not waived): blended increases to ~$0.0113 (APAC multiplier +12%)
- Rollover: we can create a global rollover pool for the account capped at 3x your average monthly usage; credits expire 6 months after issuance.
- Legal/Compliance: EU data residency addendum included in SOW; no additional fee besides minor stamping for audit logs.

Next steps:
1) Confirm absolute monthly token projection (numbers) so I can finalize the DocuSign SOW.
2) If you want the APAC waiver we need to lock a minimum 24-month term and agree to a set minimum commit for APAC (we'll propose a soft floor of 300M tokens/mo in APAC for the waiver).

If this looks good, I'll drop the DocuSign link and loop in Contracts for final redlines.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: AtlasAI_SOW_v2.pdf
From: Thomas Chen <thomas@atlasai.com>

Date: 2027-02-17T11:01:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — commit tiers & region mix (AtlasAI)

Rishi — thanks, that helps. A couple clarifying points before we go to signature: 
1) The blended calc you showed assumed identical per-region list prices — if we have region-differentiated tiers, can you show a worked example where EU base is +3% (regulatory overhead) and APAC base is +12% (unless waived)?
2) Rollover: you mentioned "global pool capped at 3x avg monthly usage" — are credits transferrable between regions if we grow APAC faster than expected?
3) For the APAC waiver, the soft floor of 300M tokens/mo — can that be a rolling commitment (i.e., averaged quarterly), or does it need to be met every single month?

If we can get those answers in writing I'll route to procurement. Assuming yes on the waiver flexibility we'll be ready to sign next week.

—Thomas
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-17T15:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AtlasAI — finance notes on rollover / APAC waiver (internal)

Short finance confirmation for the thread: 
- We can allow global rollover credits that are region-transferable up to the global pool cap (i.e., credits in the pool are fungible across regions). That increases our exposure slightly but it's manageable if we cap the pool at 3x avg monthly usage.
- Rollover expiry = 6 months from issuance; accounting prefers that term for revenue recognition simplicity.
- APAC waiver: OK to offer first 6 months waiver if the contract includes a quarterly true-up and rolling quarterly floor (averaged over the quarter) rather than strict monthly floor. That reduces churn risk.

I'll draft the finance bullet points for the SOW (to be attached).

Mina
Director, Finance Operations
